document.text: Harbor Retail Corp. reported second-quarter revenue of $4.1 billion, up 6% from a year earlier. Net income was $310 million, compared with $295 million in the same quarter last year. The board declared a quarterly dividend of $0.40 per share, payable on September 12 to holders of record on August 28.
